blocks.text: Release overview

iOS 17.0 was publicly released on September 18, 2023. iOS 17 was the annual platform release, centered on more expressive calling and messaging, a glanceable charging display, proximity sharing, and broad refinements to typing, browsing, maps, health, privacy, and accessibility.

Contact Posters and Live Voicemail reshaped Phone, while StandBy created a full-screen landscape view during charging. NameDrop, interactive widgets, Safari profiles, and offline maps broadened everyday workflows; availability still varied by device and region.
Release overview
iOS 17.0.1 was publicly released on September 21, 2023. iOS 17.0.1 was an early maintenance and security update released three days after iOS 17.
Apple’s security advisory documented Kernel, signature-validation, and WebKit fixes, and said reports indicated the three issues may have been actively exploited against older iOS versions.
Release overview
iOS 17.0.2 was publicly released on September 26, 2023. This record represents the broad iOS 17.0.2 public release on September 26, 2023, not the separate iPhone 15-only listing dated September 21.

Apple said the update corrected a setup problem that could block direct transfer from another iPhone. Its update note characterized the release as including security work, while Apple’s security index says there were no published CVE entries.
Release overview
iOS 17.0.3 was publicly released on October 4, 2023. iOS 17.0.3 combined a user-visible thermal fix with a small set of documented security remediations.
Apple said the update addressed iPhone temperatures running higher than expected. The security advisory separately lists a kernel privilege issue and a WebRTC/libvpx memory-safety issue.
Release overview

iOS 17.1 was publicly released on October 25, 2023. iOS 17.1 extended AirDrop beyond proximity, expanded Apple Music favorites, and refined StandBy while also delivering maintenance and security updates.

Transfers could continue over the internet after devices moved out of AirDrop range. Music gained broader favorites and playlist suggestions, and supported always-on iPhones received more StandBy display controls.
Release overview
iOS 17.1.1 was publicly released on November 7, 2023. iOS 17.1.1 was a focused bug-fix release for two named problems affecting NFC services and the Weather Lock Screen widget.

blocks.text: Release overview
iOS 17.1.2 was publicly released on November 30, 2023. iOS 17.1.2 was a security-only public update centered on two WebKit vulnerabilities.

Apple documented an out-of-bounds read that could expose sensitive information and a memory-corruption issue that could enable code execution. Both entries noted reports of exploitation against versions before iOS 16.7.1.
Release overview

iOS 17.2 was publicly released on December 11, 2023. iOS 17.2 was a substantial feature release led by the new Journal app, with additions spanning the Action button, camera capture, Messages, Weather, Music, forms, and security.
The release added spatial video capture on supported iPhone 15 Pro models, Translate for the Action button, Contact Key Verification in Messages, richer Weather data, and improved form filling.
Release overview
iOS 17.2.1 was publicly released on December 19, 2023. iOS 17.2.1 was a maintenance release that Apple described only as containing important bug fixes.

blocks.text: Release overview

iOS 17.3 was publicly released on January 22, 2024. iOS 17.3 introduced Stolen Device Protection and playlist collaboration, alongside a Unity wallpaper, hotel AirPlay support, maintenance, and security fixes.

Stolen Device Protection added biometric-only gates and a time-delayed second authentication for selected sensitive account changes. Apple Music collaboration let invited participants edit a playlist and react to tracks.
Release overview
iOS 17.3.1 was publicly released on February 8, 2024. iOS 17.3.1 was a narrowly documented typing correction.

blocks.text: Release overview

iOS 17.4 was publicly released on March 5, 2024. iOS 17.4 delivered Podcast transcripts, new emoji, broader Stolen Device Protection settings, and several Wallet, Siri, music-recognition, business-messaging, and device-information enhancements.

On supported iPhone 15 models, Battery Health exposed cycle count and manufacturing and first-use dates. Podcasts gained synchronized searchable transcripts, and Stolen Device Protection could require its stronger behavior in every location.
Release overview
iOS 17.4.1 was publicly released on March 21, 2024. iOS 17.4.1 was a maintenance and security release with a narrowly scoped public advisory.
Apple associated the update with an out-of-bounds write affecting image processing and listed the same CVE under CoreMedia and WebRTC.
Release overview
iOS 17.5 was publicly released on May 13, 2024. iOS 17.5 added Apple News+ offline access and puzzle features, cross-platform unwanted-tracker alerts, a Pride Radiance wallpaper, and security fixes.

News+ could retain the Today feed and News+ tab for offline use, and Quartiles joined the puzzle catalog with player statistics. Tracking notifications expanded to compatible Bluetooth trackers paired with other operating systems.
Release overview
iOS 17.5.1 was publicly released on May 20, 2024. iOS 17.5.1 was a focused Photos database repair.

blocks.text: Release overview
iOS 17.6 was publicly released on July 29, 2024. iOS 17.6 was a maintenance release whose consumer note emphasized bug fixes and security updates rather than new features.
Apple’s security advisory documents fixes across AirDrop, code-signing and privacy controls, media processing, the kernel, WebKit, and other components.
Release overview
iOS 17.6.1 was publicly released on August 7, 2024. iOS 17.6.1 corrected an Advanced Data Protection control problem.

blocks.text: Release overview
iOS 17.7 was publicly released on September 16, 2024. iOS 17.7 was a security-focused maintenance branch released alongside the next major iOS generation.

Apple’s advisory documents fixes involving locked-device accessibility state, crafted files and archives, user-data access, WebKit, and other system components. The consumer note does not advertise new features.
Release overview

iPadOS 17.0 was publicly released on September 18, 2023. iPadOS 17 brought deep Lock Screen customization, interactive widgets, the Health app, richer PDF and Notes workflows, and more flexible Stage Manager behavior to iPad.
The release also carried the shared Messages, FaceTime, Safari, password, keyboard, privacy, and accessibility work of the 17 generation, with capability differences by iPad model.
Release overview

iPadOS 17.1 was publicly released on October 25, 2023. iPadOS 17.1 extended AirDrop transfers over the internet, expanded Apple Music favorites, added Apple Pencil (USB-C) support, and delivered maintenance and security fixes.
The release also improved Screen Time synchronization, keyboard responsiveness, Matter lock support, and Photo Shuffle selection.
Release overview

iPadOS 17.2 was publicly released on December 11, 2023. iPadOS 17.2 focused on PDF AutoFill, Messages and Weather enhancements, private Health access through Siri on supported devices, and maintenance and security updates.
Messages added navigation and Contact Key Verification, Weather gained deeper precipitation and wind views, and Music received Favorite Songs and Focus-aware listening-history controls.
Release overview

iPadOS 17.3 was publicly released on January 22, 2024. iPadOS 17.3 added collaborative Apple Music playlists, a Unity wallpaper, selected hotel AirPlay support, warranty visibility, and security fixes.
Participants could add, reorder, and remove playlist tracks and respond with emoji. Unlike iOS 17.3, Apple’s iPadOS notes do not list Stolen Device Protection.
Release overview

iPadOS 17.4 was publicly released on March 5, 2024. iPadOS 17.4 delivered Podcast transcripts, new emoji, music-recognition and business-messaging enhancements, Apple Cash virtual card numbers, Safari favorites-bar controls, and security fixes.

Podcasts gained synchronized searchable transcripts with accessibility support. Safari could show website icons without titles in the Favorites Bar, while Find My received a contact-picture correction.
Release overview

iPadOS 17.5 was publicly released on May 13, 2024. iPadOS 17.5 added Apple News+ offline access and puzzle features, cross-platform unwanted-tracker alerts, a Pride Radiance wallpaper, and security fixes.

News+ could retain selected feeds for offline use, and Quartiles joined the puzzle catalog with player statistics. Tracking notifications expanded to compatible Bluetooth trackers paired with other operating systems.
Release overview
iPadOS 17.6 was publicly released on July 29, 2024. iPadOS 17.6 was a maintenance release whose consumer note emphasized bug fixes and security updates rather than new features.
Apple’s security advisory documents fixes across AirDrop, code-signing and privacy controls, media processing, the kernel, WebKit, and other components.

What changed

Contact Posters and Live Voicemail reshaped Phone, while StandBy created a full-screen landscape view during charging. NameDrop, interactive widgets, Safari profiles, and offline maps broadened everyday workflows; availability still varied by device and region.
